workflow:
name: Release

# The family's standard release: a pushed v<version> tag is checked, packed, attached to the
# GitHub Release and published to npm through trusted publishing (OIDC). No npm token is stored.
#
# npmjs.com side (package Settings -> Trusted publisher) must name:
#   Organization or user  kubohiroya
#   Repository            sb3-toolchain
#   Workflow filename     release.yml   <- the filename alone
#   Environment           (empty)
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
        # No registry-url: it writes an .npmrc with a placeholder token, and npm sends a configured
        # token instead of exchanging the workflow identity, so publishing fails with
        # "OIDC permission denied".
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run check
      - name: Check the tag names the package version
        run: |
          version="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
          if [ "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" != "$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not name package.json version $version."
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Pack the npm archive
        id: pack
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm"
          npm pack --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack.json"
          file="$(node -p "const r = require(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + '/pack.json'); (Array.isArray(r) ? r[0] : Object.values(r)[0]).filename")"
          echo "file=$RUNNER_TEMP/npm/$file" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Attach to the GitHub Release
        # An attachment that already exists must be byte-identical: a release driver may have
        # uploaded its locally verified archive first, and a differing CI build stops here,
        # before anything reaches npm.
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NPM_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          name="$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")"
          version="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
          if ! gh release view "$tag" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            prerelease=()
            case "$version" in *-*) prerelease=(--prerelease) ;; esac
            gh release create "$tag" --verify-tag --title "$name $version" --generate-notes "${prerelease[@]}" ||
              gh release view "$tag" > /dev/null
          fi
          existing="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$tag" --jq '.assets[] | "\(.name)\t\(.digest)"')"
          shopt -s nullglob
          for file in "$NPM_ARCHIVE"; do
            want="sha256:$(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
            have="$(printf '%s\n' "$existing" | awk -F'\t' -v n="$(basename "$file")" '$1 == n { print $2 }')"
            if [ -z "$have" ]; then
              gh release upload "$tag" "$file"
            elif [ "$have" != "$want" ]; then
              echo "::error::$(basename "$file") is already attached with different content."
              exit 1
            fi
          done
      - name: Use an npm that supports trusted publishing
        run: npm install --global npm@11.21.0
      - name: Publish to npm
        # Last step: a failed check or mismatched tag stops the release before the registry,
        # where a version cannot be replaced.
        env:
          NPM_ARCHIVE: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          name="$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")"
          version="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
          want="$(sha1sum "$NPM_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          have="$(npm view "$name@$version" dist.shasum --prefer-online 2> /dev/null || true)"
          if [ -n "$have" ]; then
            if [ "$have" != "$want" ]; then
              echo "::error::$name@$version is already published with different content."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "$name@$version is already published with this archive."
          else
            dist_tag="$(node -p "require('./package.json').publishConfig?.tag ?? ''")"
            if [ -z "$dist_tag" ]; then
              case "$version" in *-*) dist_tag=next ;; *) dist_tag=latest ;; esac
            fi
            npm publish "$NPM_ARCHIVE" --access public --provenance --tag "$dist_tag"
          fi
          # Accepting a publish and serving it differ; wait for the registry itself.
          for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
            have="$(npm view "$name@$version" dist.shasum --prefer-online 2> /dev/null || true)"
            [ -n "$have" ] && break
            sleep 10
          done
          if [ "$have" != "$want" ]; then
            echo "::error::The registry does not serve $name@$version with the packed archive."
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Point latest and next at this release
        # The family keeps both dist-tags on the newest verified release
        # (kubohiroya/turbowarp-plus-packages#16).
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          name="$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")"
          version="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
          for tag in latest next; do
            if [ "$(npm view "$name" "dist-tags.$tag" --prefer-online 2> /dev/null || true)" != "$version" ]; then
              npm dist-tag add "$name@$version" "$tag"
            fi
          done

workflow:
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release:
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # `pnpm verify:release` is `verify:full`: checks, tests, e2e, build and the pack smoke test.
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - run: corepack enable
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
        # No registry-url. It writes an .npmrc whose auth token is the literal placeholder
        # XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX when no token is supplied, and a configured credential -- even a
        # bogus one -- is what npm sends instead of exchanging the workflow identity, so the
        # publish is refused as "OIDC permission denied". package.json already names the registry
        # in publishConfig, so nothing else needed this.
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      # The same verification a release is cut against, run here against the tagged tree.
      - run: pnpm verify:release
      - name: Check the tag names the version being released
        # The registry will not accept a replacement for a version already published, so a tag
        # that does not match package.json either publishes something nobody asked for or fails
        # after the release is already cut.
        run: |
          tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          version="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
          if [ "$tag" != "$version" ]; then
            echo "Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not name package.json version $version." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Use an npm that can publish without a stored token
        # Trusted publishing needs npm 11.5.1 or newer. The pinned Node already ships one, so this
        # only keeps the requirement from depending on which npm happens to come with a future
        # bump.
        run: npm install -g npm@11.21.0
      - name: Publish to npm
        # No token in this repository. npm checks this workflow's identity against the package's
        # trusted publisher on npmjs.com, and the credential it issues lives for the length of the
        # job. Provenance is attached without asking.
        #
        # No --tag: publishConfig.tag in package.json is already `next`, which is what the 4.0.0-rc
        # series publishes under. A --tag here would only be another place to keep in step with it.
        #
        # The half of the setting that is not in this file is on npmjs.com, under the package's
        # Settings -> Trusted publisher. Four fields have to match, and one mismatch is a 403
        # "OIDC permission denied":
        #
        #   Organization or user  kubohiroya
        #   Repository            turbowarp-kamishibai-app
        #   Workflow filename     release.yml   <- the filename alone; the path
        #                                         .github/workflows/release.yml does not match
        #   Environment           (empty)       <- this workflow declares no `environment:`, so a
        #                                         name here does not match
        #
        # The trusted publisher must permit direct npm publish, not only npm stage publish.
        # Trusted publishing does not require weakening the package's two-factor policy.
        #
        # Accepting a publish and serving it are different things -- in the sibling repository a
        # version took about 80 seconds to appear in the registry after a successful job, so
        # `release:dsl4:record-publication` and any downstream update have to wait for the registry
        # itself.
        #
        # Publication follows validation, so a failed check or mismatched tag stops the release before anything
        # reaches the registry, where it cannot be taken back.
        run: npm publish
      - name: Complete release and verify latest and next
        run: node scripts/finalize-release-tags.ts "$(node -p 'require("./package.json").name')" "$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')"

  publish-existing:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Install OIDC-capable npm
        run: npm install --global npm@11.21.0
      - name: Download verified rc.58 release artifact
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh release download v4.0.0-rc.58 --repo kubohiroya/turbowarp-kamishibai-app --pattern kubohiroya-turbowarp-kamishibai-app-4.0.0-rc.58.tgz
          echo 'aa693ab4c8d5d08275985abc7c7da923eccd4619  kubohiroya-turbowarp-kamishibai-app-4.0.0-rc.58.tgz' | sha1sum --check
          tar -xOf kubohiroya-turbowarp-kamishibai-app-4.0.0-rc.58.tgz package/package.json > package-metadata.json
          node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-metadata.json')); if (p.name !== '@kubohiroya/turbowarp-kamishibai-app' || p.version !== '4.0.0-rc.58' || p.publishConfig?.tag !== 'next') throw new Error('Unexpected package');"
      - name: Publish verified tarball with provenance to next
        run: |
          test "$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')" = '4.0.0-rc.58'
          if npm view @kubohiroya/turbowarp-kamishibai-app@4.0.0-rc.58 version --json --prefer-online > published-version.json; then
            test "$(npm view @kubohiroya/turbowarp-kamishibai-app@4.0.0-rc.58 dist.shasum --prefer-online)" = 'aa693ab4c8d5d08275985abc7c7da923eccd4619'
          else
            node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('published-version.json')); if (p.error?.code !== 'E404') throw Error('Cannot confirm unpublished version');"
            npm publish ./kubohiroya-turbowarp-kamishibai-app-4.0.0-rc.58.tgz --access public --tag next --provenance
          fi
      - name: Complete release and verify latest and next
        run: node scripts/finalize-release-tags.ts @kubohiroya/turbowarp-kamishibai-app 4.0.0-rc.58
